verses.en: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Israel, a congregação toda, chegaram ao deserto de Zim no primeiro mês, e o povo ficou em Cades. Ali morreu Miriã, e ali foi sepultada.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.en_bbe: In the first month all the children of Israel came into the waste land of Zin, and put up their tents in Kadesh; there death came to Miriam, and they put her body to rest in the earth.

verses.en: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.pt: Ora, não havia água para a congregação; pelo que se ajuntaram contra Moisés e Arão.
verses.en_web: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.en_bbe: And there was no water for the people: and they came together against Moses and against Aaron.

verses.en: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
verses.pt: E o povo contendeu com Moisés, dizendo: Oxalá tivéssemos perecido quando pereceram nossos irmãos perante o Senhor!
verses.en_web: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!
verses.en_bbe: And the people were angry with Moses and said, If only death had overtaken us when our brothers came to their death before the Lord!

verses.en: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
verses.pt: Por que trouxestes a congregação do Senhor a este deserto, para que morramos aqui, nós e os nossos animais?
verses.en_web: Why have you brought Yahweh’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?
verses.en_bbe: Why have you taken the Lord's people into this waste, for death to come to us and to our cattle there?

verses.en: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
verses.pt: E por que nos fizestes subir do Egito, para nos trazer a este mau lugar? lugar onde não há semente, nem figos, nem vides, nem romãs, nem mesmo água para beber.
verses.en_web: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”
verses.en_bbe: Why have you made us come out of Egypt into this evil place? This is no place of seed or figs or vines or other fruits, and there is no water for drinking.

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.
verses.pt: Então Moisés e Arão se foram da presença da assembléia até a porta da tenda da revelação, e se lançaram com o rosto em terra; e a glória do Senhor lhes apareceu.
verses.en_web: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. Yahweh’s glory appeared to them.
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses and Aaron went away from the people to the door of the Tent of meeting; and, falling on their faces there, they saw the glory of the Lord.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: E o Senhor disse a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
verses.pt: Toma a vara, e ajunta a congregação, tu e Arão, teu irmão, e falai à rocha perante os seus olhos, que ela dê as suas águas. Assim lhes tirarás água da rocha, e darás a beber à congregação e aos seus animais.
verses.en_web: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”
verses.en_bbe: Take the rod, you and Aaron, your brother, and make all the people come together, and before their eyes give orders to the rock to give out its water; and so make water come out of the rock for them, and give the people and their cattle drink.

verses.en: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
verses.pt: Moisés, pois, tomou a vara de diante do senhor, como este lhe ordenou.
verses.en_web: Moses took the rod from before Yahweh, as he commanded him.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses took the rod from before the Lord as he gave him orders.

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
verses.pt: Moisés e Arão reuniram a assembléia diante da rocha, e Moisés disse-lhes: Ouvi agora, rebeldes! Porventura tiraremos água desta rocha para vós?
verses.en_web: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses and Aaron made the people come together in front of the rock, and he said to them, Give ear now, you people whose hearts are turned from the Lord; are we to get water for you out of the rock?

verses.en: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
verses.pt: Então Moisés levantou a mão, e feriu a rocha duas vezes com a sua vara, e saiu água copiosamente, e a congregação bebeu, e os seus animais.
verses.en_web: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.
verses.en_bbe: And lifting up his hand, Moses gave the rock two blows with his rod: and water came streaming out, and the people and their cattle had drink enough.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
verses.pt: Pelo que o Senhor disse a Moisés e a Arão: Porquanto não me crestes a mim, para me santificardes diante dos filhos de Israel, por isso não introduzireis esta congregação na terra que lhes dei.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, Because you had not enough faith in me to keep my name holy before the children of Israel, you will not take this people into the land which I have given them.

verses.en: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
verses.pt: Estas são as águas de Meribá, porque ali os filhos de Israel contenderam com o Senhor, que neles se santificou.
verses.en_web: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.
verses.en_bbe: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel went against the Lord, and they saw that he was holy among them.

verses.en: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:
verses.pt: De Cades, Moisés enviou mensageiros ao rei de Edom, dizendo: Assim diz teu irmão Israel: Tu sabes todo o trabalho que nos tem sobrevindo;
verses.en_web: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the travail that has happened to us;
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses sent men from Kadesh to the king of Edom to say to him, Your brother Israel says, You have knowledge of all the things we have been through;

verses.en: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
verses.pt: como nossos pais desceram ao Egito, e nós no Egito habitamos muito tempo; e como os egípcios nos maltrataram, a nós e a nossos pais;
verses.en_web: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.
verses.en_bbe: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we were living in Egypt for a long time; and the Egyptians were cruel to us and to our fathers:

verses.en: And when we cried unto the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
verses.pt: e quando clamamos ao Senhor, ele ouviu a nossa voz, e mandou um anjo, e nos tirou do Egito; e eis que estamos em Cades, cidade na extremidade dos teus termos.
verses.en_web: When we cried to Yahweh, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord gave ear to the voice of our cry, and sent an angel and took us out of Egypt: and now we are in Kadesh, a town on the edge of your land;

verses.en: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king’s high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
verses.pt: Deixa-nos, pois, passar pela tua terra; não passaremos pelos campos, nem pelas vinhas, nem beberemos a água dos poços; iremos pela estrada real, não nos desviando para a direita nem para a esquerda, até que tenhamos passado os teus termos.
verses.en_web: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”
verses.en_bbe: Let us now go through your land: we will not go into field or vine-garden, or take the water of the springs; we will go by the highway, not turning to the right or to the left, till we have gone past the limits of your land.

verses.en: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Edom: Não passaras por mim, para que eu não saia com a espada ao teu encontro.
verses.en_web: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”
verses.en_bbe: And Edom said, You are not to go through my land, for if you do I will come out against you with the sword.

verses.en: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else, go through on my feet.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Israel lhe replicaram: Subiremos pela estrada real; e se bebermos das tuas águas, eu e o meu gado, darei o preço delas; sob condição de eu nada mais fazer, deixa-me somente passar a pé.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel said to him, We will go up by the highway: and if we or our cattle take of your water, we will give you a price for it: only let us go through on our feet, nothing more.

verses.en: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
verses.pt: Edom, porém, respondeu: Não passarás. E saiu-lhe ao encontro com muita gente e com mão forte.
verses.en_web: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.
verses.en_bbe: But he said, You are not to go through. And Edom came out against them in his strength, with a great army.

verses.en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
verses.pt: Assim recusou Edom deixar Israel passar pelos seus termos; pelo que Israel se desviou dele.
verses.en_web: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.
verses.en_bbe: So Edom would not let Israel go through his land; and Israel went in another direction.

verses.en: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
verses.pt: Então partiram de Cades; e os filhos de Israel, a congregação toda, chegaram ao monte Hor.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Kadesh: and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Kadesh, and came, with all their people, to Mount Hor.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés e a Arão no monte Hor, nos termos da terra de Edom, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And at Mount Hor, at the edge of the land of Edom, the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.en: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
verses.pt: Arão será recolhido a seu povo, porque não entrará na terra que dei aos filhos de Israel, porquanto fostes rebeldes contra a minha palavra no tocante às águas de Meribá.
verses.en_web: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.
verses.en_bbe: Aaron will be put to rest with his people; he will not go into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you went against my word at the waters of Meribah.

verses.en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
verses.pt: Toma a Arão e a Eleazar, seu filho, e faze-os subir ao monte Hor;
verses.en_web: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;
verses.en_bbe: So take Aaron and Eleazar, his son, up into Mount Hor;

verses.en: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.
verses.pt: e despe a Arão as suas vestes, e as veste a Eleazar, seu filho, porque Arão será recolhido, e morrerá ali.
verses.en_web: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”
verses.en_bbe: And take Aaron's robes off him and put them on Eleazar, his son: and death will come to Aaron there, and he will be put to rest with his people.

verses.en: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.pt: Fez, pois, Moisés como o Senhor lhe ordenara; e subiram ao monte Hor perante os olhos de toda a congregação.
verses.en_web: Moses did as Yahweh commanded. They went up into Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses did as the Lord had said, and before the eyes of all the people they went up Mount Hor.

verses.en: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
verses.pt: Moisés despiu a Arão as vestes, e as vestiu a Eleazar, seu filho; e morreu Arão ali sobre o cume do monte; e Moisés e Eleazar desceram do monte.
verses.en_web: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses took off Aaron's robes, and put them on Eleazar, his son; and there on the top of the mountain death came to Aaron: then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

verses.en: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
verses.pt: Vendo, pois, toda a congregação que Arão era morto, chorou-o toda a casa de Israel por trinta dias.
verses.en_web: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And when the people saw that Aaron was dead, all the children of Israel gave themselves up to weeping for him for thirty days.
